lens: Editorial and brand craft; keyboard-oriented use (simulated AI panel lens)
reason: The public presentation is coherent and carefully composed: restrained sans/mono roles, numbered sections, hairline structure, clear client/student actions, and a real, accurately captioned member photograph survive the supplied desktop/mobile layouts. The proposition explains student-led research and recommendations without invented outcomes. Organization figures and named partnerships precede people, but the central promise still lacks an inspectable engagement or actual work artifact. That limits world-class editorial persuasion for a client choosing a consulting team. I traced Home → Client Services → Contact in source and the supplied client-journey test/log; the inquiry confirmation uses intercepted HTTP. Native station buttons, a skip link, focus styles and menu Escape return support keyboard intent, but this is not observed end-to-end keyboard success. This independent AI assessment does not establish human endorsement or hosted release readiness.

findings.evidence: The captured Selected work section renders the fallback at home/page.tsx:78-80: general industry coverage and “Case studies pending client approval.” Lines 88-95 then supply organization names/sectors, rather than a project question, method or handoff. PUBLIC_PROJECTS is empty. The only homepage photograph, lines 135-136, is correctly identified as a PwC visit, not project evidence. Both full-page captures show this proof gap.
findings.userImpact: A prospective client can verify the claimed kinds of partners and understand the proposed process, but cannot judge the specificity or quality of the team’s actual consulting work before inquiring.
findings.suggestedFix: Obtain client and MECG approval for one concise engagement example: the actual decision, methods, constraints and handoff, plus a redacted deliverable excerpt if permitted. Publish through the existing approval boundary and feature it before the people section. Keep the honest pending status until approval; do not fabricate a result or repurpose culture photography as project proof.

notVerified: No staging, deployment or hosted Clerk/Supabase/storage/email integration evidence exists; contact delivery and actual board response time remain unverified.

No complete Tab/Shift+Tab/Enter/Space journey was observed. The supplied menu test clicks its trigger and programmatically focuses a link before Escape; the station test uses clicks. Focus visibility during scroll, zoom, FAQ operation and browser navigation therefore remain important keyboard unknowns.
No physical-device, Safari, Firefox, assistive-technology or human task-success evidence. Captures use Linux fallback fonts; other system-font metrics were not visually verified.

Client publication approval, underlying organization statistics and original-resume policy approval were not independently authenticated. Reviewed applicant copy accurately discloses original-PDF access; that is not anonymization.
Private operator/applicant workflows beyond the sampled privacy copy were outside this editorial seat’s direct inspection.
